root_idea.summary: The root centers on reciprocal exchange—taking and giving in return—with related branches for equivalence, spreading vegetation, and heightened or agitated movement.
root_idea.development: The exchange branch covers selling, buying, and treating one thing as the equivalent of another. A separate botanical branch names spreading plants and trees, while another semantic branch develops into agitation, intensity, persistence, and expansion.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I citation form شَرَى.
Displayed under the normalized Form VIII citation form اِشْتَرَى.

senses.definition: To sell: to give up a thing or oneself in exchange for a price or counterpart.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic Form I occurrences, the verb is used for selling or surrendering something in an exchange, including oneself or one's worldly life; the exchange need not be a literal monetary sale.

senses.definition: To buy or acquire by giving a price or another thing in exchange; to enter into an ordinary purchase or barter.
senses.usage_conditions: The exchange may involve money and goods or one commodity for another; in a reciprocal transaction, each party may be viewed as buying what it receives.

senses.definition: Figuratively, to take or choose one thing in exchange for relinquishing another; hence to prefer or obtain a value at the expense of another.
senses.usage_conditions: This construction includes choosing error, worldly life, falsehood, or a small return instead of guidance, truth, divine signs, or covenant, as well as the figurative purchase of believers and their possessions in return for divine reward.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To advance before a group against an enemy and fight in its defense; also to go before a ruler to speak for a people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiom شَرَى بِنَفْسِهِ, with the person putting himself forward for others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mock, scoff at, laugh at, or ridicule someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive colloquial or idiomatic use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To anger or wrong someone, or to cause displeasure, grief, or vexation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe an act that occasions harm or distress; also said of God in the cited expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of God, to smite someone with the skin eruption called شَرًى.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized causative use referring to the eruption named شَرًى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To spread flesh, a garment, cloth, or curd to dry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is something laid out for drying.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of lightning, to shine or gleam repeatedly and spread across the face of the clouds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes successive or expansive flashes rather than a single isolated flash.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel's nose-rein, to be agitated or in a state of much commotion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use for the movement of the nose-rein.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become angry or flurried through anger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of evil, mischief, an affair, or an event, to spread, become great, or become formidable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may describe expansion among people or increasing seriousness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To persist or persevere intensely in an affair, error, corrupt conduct, pace, or running; to continue without slackening.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Of a horse, the verb can describe exceeding the usual bounds of its pace or straining its bridle; of an eye, it can describe tears flowing continuously.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break out with the bodily eruption called شَرًى.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be said of a person or of the skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To buy and sell mutually with another; to barter or exchange commodities with him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form III construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To persist in contention, litigation, wrangling, or vehement dispute with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may describe obstinate altercation or legal dispute.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel, to speed or go quickly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV use said of the animal's movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To excite discord, strife, or animosity between people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a phrase indicating the people among whom discord is caused.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a lamb, to have its wool cleave open or become separated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use describing the state of the lamb's fleece.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a plant, to creep or spread along the ground like a cucumber or melon plant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a plant's prostrate growth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fill a watering-trough, bowl, or bowls prepared for guests.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form IV use for filling a container.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something incline or turn toward a direction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe the eyes or gaze being drawn toward something, or a person turning toward it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a bridle in motion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use with a bridle as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become scattered or dispersed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said especially of a company or group of people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become like the Shurāt in conduct or actions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form V comparison referring to the group called the Shurāt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sue each other or bring each other before a judge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal legal construction, synonymous with mutual litigation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To persist or persevere in consideration or examination.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X use describing sustained inspection or deliberation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strive diligently and apply oneself carefully in religious practice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction استشرى في دينه specifies the field of exertion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of affairs or events, to become great or formidable among people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes increasing seriousness or magnitude between or among people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become in a state of commotion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form XII intensive or expansive state description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The colocynth, its plant, or its leaves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical noun, also used for the plant as a whole; it is associated with bitterness in the cited comparison.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Any plant that spreads, runs, or creeps along the ground, such as a melon or cucumber plant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader botanical use than the specific colocynth sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm tree that grows from a date stone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With the feminine form, it can name one such palm tree as an individual plant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of tree from which bows are made.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical identification distinct from the colocynth plant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A road or tract of land; also an adjacent district or side, especially the named mountain or region al-Sharā.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Al-Sharā is described as a lion-abounding place, and the plural may denote surrounding or adjacent tracts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical noun distinct from the broader road or tract use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The worst or inferior cattle, or, in another reported usage, the best or choicest cattle; especially choice camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexicographical evidence records opposite evaluations, so the intended value depends on usage and authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A skin eruption consisting of small, burning, itching, red pimples or purulent pustules.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The eruption may appear suddenly or gradually and is described as becoming worse at night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of an idol associated with the tribe of Daws in al-Sarāt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper name in pre-Islamic Arabian religious usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Affected by the skin eruption called شَرًى.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a person or body bearing that eruption.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sale or a purchase.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun of شَرَى; the term can cover either side of the exchange.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sold or bought, applied to a male slave.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited lexical application is specifically to a male slave; the feminine form is شَرِيَّةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse that persists or exceeds the usual bounds of its pace without languor; also a choice or excellent horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use combining sustained vigor with excellence of quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A way, course, mode, or manner of conduct; a nature or innate disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract noun for a characteristic manner or temper.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who bears female children.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of women according to the sex of the children they bear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The like or equivalent of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used alike as singular or plural in the cited usage; it can denote an equivalent replacement or counterpart.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Relating to selling or buying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective formed from the verbal nouns of the exchange branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mountain tree of the bow-making kind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The tree is described as related in kind to other bow woods and as having a single-unit feminine form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An artery, or pulsing vein, especially one arising from the heart.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct anatomical use; the plural is شَرَايِينُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A crack or fissure in a rock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized geological use, synonymous with a named type of cleft.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller or selling person; also a buyer or buying person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form is generally used for a seller, while the buyer sense is also attested; its plural in the seller sense is شُرَاةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A member of the Shurāt, an appellation for the Kharijites.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The designation is explained in several ways in the lexical tradition, including the idea of selling oneself for God's obedience or for what the group believed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A well-known star, identified as Jupiter and counted among the Seven Stars.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper or conventional astronomical name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain bird.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological noun with no further identification in the supplied evidence.

cautions: شَرَى and اِشْتَرَى belong to the same exchange domain but are not interchangeable in every Quranic occurrence: the supplied Form I occurrences support selling, while Form VIII also expresses buying and figurative acquisition or preference.

The exchange vocabulary can describe either side of a reciprocal transaction, so translations such as sell, buy, exchange, and purchase depend on the construction and what is treated as the item given or received.
